text:
Harper: Logged a mobile UX bug — when the right sidebar slides in on narrow phones the runs table pushes into a horizontal scroll and CTAs disappear. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/mobile-cta-clip
Izzy: Repro on iPhone SE emulator. Looks like table keeps min-width for some columns so it overflows. Also seen a duplicated thin header after rotate.
Samir: Short-term: add a sticky actions column (small width with overflow menu) so actions remain reachable at all widths. Long-term: switch to compact cards under a lower breakpoint.
Lin: Proposal for breakpoints: <372px -> compact cards, 372-420px -> condensed table with sticky actions column, >420px -> full table. Product prefers preserving table for power users when possible.
Harper: Accessibility items: ensure sticky actions are keyboard reachable, actions have aria-expanded + aria-controls, and we announce count changes via aria-live polite when filters change. Also focus must be trapped in the sidebar when open.
a11y-bot: Recommend aria-modal="true" on the sidebar and set aria-hidden="true" on the inert background. Add skip-to-results link that becomes visible for keyboard users when sidebar opens. Ensure status pills meet 4.5:1 contrast and touch targets >= 44px.
Izzy: Implementation note: avoid 100vh for scroll containers (causes foldable/keyboard jumps). Use visualViewport to set --vh: ```js
const vh = (window.visualViewport?.height || window.innerHeight);
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--vh', `${vh}px`);
// then .table-wrap { height: calc(var(--vh) - var(--header-height)); }
```
Samir: For the sidebar animation we can keep using transform for smoothness but dispatch a resize after animation to force layout recalc: ```js
requestAnimationFrame(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')));
```
Lin: Visual affordance: add a subtle gradient mask at the right edge of the condensed table to indicate horizontal overflow instead of immediately showing a scrollbar. Use ellipsis for truncated cells only in compact rows.
Harper: Copy tweak: empty state text change from "No runs" -> "No runs match your filters" with hint: "Try clearing filters or widening the date range." Add live update announcing "Showing X runs" on filter changes.
Izzy: QA checklist requested: iPhone SE, Pixel 7a, Pixel Fold portrait & landscape, VoiceOver, TalkBack, keyboard nav. Include visual diffs for compact cards and condensed table.
diff-bot: Added job "mobile-condensed-table-compact-cards" to the canary visual suite. Will run on next push.
Samir: I'll open a PR with sticky actions column, --vh fix, focus-trap util, gradient overflow indicator, and the copy tweak. PR will include screenshots, accessibility checklist, and before/after diffs.
Harper: Marking P2 for the sprint unless diff-bot finds regressions. Tagging design for quick review tomorrow AM. :eyes:
